batches.name: Hicksville, Levittown, Plainview and Bethpage
batches.why: Three Hicksville parishes (Holy Family, Our Lady of Mercy, St. Ignatius Loyola), St. Bernard (Levittown), St. Pius X (Plainview, LPi 0018000000Qc2PBAAZ) and St. Martin of Tours (Bethpage). No shared pastor named. A typical batch: separate suburban parishes, mostly with their own sites.

batches.name: Five Towns, East Rockaway, Lynbrook and Valley Stream
batches.why: St. Joseph (Hewlett), St. Joachim (Cedarhurst) and Our Lady of Good Counsel (Inwood) share one pastor and one site, 5townsparishesny.com; its 'Status, Progress and Development of the Parishes of the Five Towns' booklet says they 'are still three separate Canonical and Corporate entities' (read 2026-11-12). Decide whether 5townsparishesny.com/bulletin.html is one bulletin for all three. The June 2026 appointments name one parochial vicar for the three. Also St. Raymond (East Rockaway), Our Lady of Peace (Lynbrook) and the two Valley Stream parishes (Blessed Sacrament, Holy Name of Mary), each with its own site. The locator files Blessed Sacrament under town 'Suffolk' (it is Valley Stream, Nassau).

batches.name: Long Beach, Island Park, Oceanside, Baldwin and the Cathedral
batches.why: St. Ignatius Martyr and St. Mary of the Isle (Long Beach) and Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal (Point Lookout) share beachcatholic.com, and the June 2026 appointments name parochial vicars for all three together: likely one bulletin, so settle them first. Also Sacred Heart (Island Park), St. Anthony (Oceanside), St. Christopher (Baldwin) and St. Agnes Cathedral (Rockville Centre). GCatholic does not list the cathedral; the locator and the Mass-times page do. beachcatholic.com did not answer probe url.

batches.name: Elmont, Franklin Square, Floral Park, New Hyde Park and St. Ladislaus
batches.why: Holy Spirit and Notre Dame (New Hyde Park) shared a parochial vicar until July 2026 and newhydeparkcatholic.com appears on the locator for Holy Spirit; check for a single bulletin. St. Vincent de Paul (Elmont): the deanery list still names it as a Latin parish and GCatholic says it uses the building of the Syro-Malankara St. Vincent de Paul Cathedral (directory:68 is that building, with the cathedral's site); the Mass-times page gives only 'Sunday: 8:45 AM'. Settle whether the Latin parish still has its own Mass and bulletin; the eparchy's own services go in excluded as other-jurisdiction. St. Hedwig (Floral Park) and St. Ladislaus (Hempstead), both Polish, shared a parochial vicar 'with residence at the Church of Saint Ladislaus' (June 2025 appointments): check for a shared bulletin. Also St. Boniface (Elmont, Solutio site), St. Catherine of Sienna (Franklin Square) and Our Lady of Victory (Floral Park).

batches.name: Hempstead, Roosevelt, Uniondale, Freeport, West Hempstead and Malverne
batches.why: St. Thomas the Apostle (West Hempstead) has the Lakeview Mission (locator only) on the same site, stawh.church: find whether the mission still has Mass. The Syro-Malabar St. Mary's uses the St. Thomas building (GCatholic) and is in the eastern-catholic batch. Queen of the Most Holy Rosary (Roosevelt) and St. Martha (Uniondale) share a pastor, Fr. Rony Fabien (second terms at St. Martha, June 2025, and at Queen of the Most Holy Rosary, June 2026) and until 2025 a parochial vicar: check for one bulletin. Also Our Lady of Loretto (Hempstead), Our Holy Redeemer (Freeport), Our Lady of Lourdes (Malverne). The Mass-times page links the wrong sites for several of these; trust the parish's own site.

batches.name: Merrick, Bellmore, Seaford, Wantagh and East Meadow
batches.why: Cure of Ars (Merrick), Sacred Heart (North Merrick, hearttoheartparish.org; the Mass-times page lists it twice, under Merrick and North Merrick), St. Barnabas (Bellmore), three Seaford parishes (St. James, Maria Regina, St. William the Abbot), St. Frances de Chantal (Wantagh) and St. Raphael (East Meadow). No shared pastor named; cureofarschurch.net does not resolve (the Mass-times page has cureofarschurch.org).

batches.name: Massapequa, Farmingdale, Amityville, Copiague, Lindenhurst, West Babylon and Wyandanch
batches.why: St. Rose of Lima and Our Lady of Lourdes (Massapequa Park), St. Kilian (Farmingdale), St. Martin of Tours (Amityville), Our Lady of the Assumption (Copiague), Our Lady of Perpetual Help (Lindenhurst), Our Lady of Grace (West Babylon), Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal (Wyandanch). No shared pastor named. The Ukrainian Holy Family (Lindenhurst) is in eastern-catholic.

batches.name: Glen Cove, Glen Head, Sea Cliff, Bayville, Oyster Bay and Brookville
batches.why: St. Patrick and St. Rocco (Glen Cove) and St. Hyacinth (Glen Head) have one pastor from the Canonry of Saint Leopold (June 2025) and share glencovecatholic.org (LPi link on its bulletin page), and the June 2026 appointments moved a parochial vicar 'of the Church of Saint Patrick, Glen Cove, the Church of Saint Rocco, Glen Cove, the Church of Saint Hyacinth, Glen Head, and the Church of Saint Boniface Martyr, Sea Cliff': check whether Sea Cliff (saintboniface.org) shares the Glen Cove bulletin. Also St. Gertrude (Bayville), St. Dominic (Oyster Bay), St. Paul the Apostle (Brookville). The Ukrainian St. Josaphat monastery (Glen Cove) is in eastern-catholic.

batches.name: Great Neck, Manhasset, Port Washington, Roslyn, Williston Park and Mineola
batches.why: St. Aloysius (Great Neck, John Patrick jppc.net link), St. Mary (Manhasset), Our Lady of Fatima (Manorhaven, now olfpw.org) and St. Peter of Alcantara (Port Washington), St. Mary (Roslyn), St. Aidan (Williston Park), Corpus Christi (Mineola, self-hosted PDFs). No shared pastor named.

batches.name: Garden City, Carle Place, Westbury, Syosset and Woodbury
batches.why: St. Anne and St. Joseph (Garden City), Our Lady of Hope (Carle Place), St. Brigid (Westbury), St. Edward the Confessor (Syosset), Holy Name of Jesus (Woodbury). No shared pastor named. The Ruthenian St. Andrew (Westbury) is in eastern-catholic.

batches.name: Huntington, Centerport, Northport, Greenlawn, Melville and Dix Hills
batches.why: Our Lady Queen of Martyrs (Centerport) and St. Philip Neri (Northport) have one pastor (June 2025) and shared parochial vicars (June 2026): check for one bulletin. St. Anthony of Padua (East Northport) and St. Francis of Assisi (Greenlawn) shared a parochial vicar (June 2025). St. Anthony of Padua (East Northport) and St. Philip Neri are on Solutio (solutiosoftware.com) sites. Also St. Patrick (Huntington, now stpathuntington.org), St. Hugh of Lincoln (Huntington Station), St. Francis of Assisi (Greenlawn, ParishesOnline st-francis-of-assisi-church-11740), St. Elizabeth of Hungary (Melville), St. Matthew (Dix Hills; also on the diocese's Latin Mass list). gcatholic:40401 is the chapel of Immaculate Conception Seminary, Huntington: public Mass or not.

batches.name: Babylon, West Islip, Deer Park, Bay Shore, Brentwood and Central Islip
batches.why: St. Joseph (Babylon) and its Oak Beach mission church (only the Mass-times page lists it; check it still has Mass), Our Lady of Lourdes (West Islip), Ss. Cyril and Methodius (Deer Park; sscyrilandmethodius.org does not resolve), St. Patrick (Bay Shore), St. Anne and St. Luke (Brentwood), St. John of God (Central Islip).

batches.name: Islips, Sayville, Bohemia, Blue Point, Holbrook and Fire Island
batches.why: St. Mary (East Islip) and St. Peter the Apostle (Islip Terrace; stpetersnyit.org does not resolve) share a parochial vicar (June 2025): check for one bulletin. St. Lawrence the Martyr (Sayville), St. John Nepomucene (Bohemia), Our Lady of the Snow (Blue Point), Good Shepherd (Holbrook), and three summer churches on Fire Island: Our Lady of the Magnificat (Ocean Beach), Our Lady Star of the Sea (Saltaire) and Most Precious Blood (Davis Park), listed in the locator under oceanbeachcatholic.org. Ocean Beach posts one '2026 Seasonal Bulletin' PDF; find which mainland parish (if any) each belongs to and see the proposed seasonal-church rule. GCatholic has no Saltaire entry.

batches.name: Patchogue, Bellport, Mastic Beach, Medford, Farmingville and Ronkonkoma
batches.why: Our Lady of Mount Carmel and St. Francis de Sales (Patchogue), St. Joseph the Worker (East Patchogue; stjosephtheworker.weconnect.com, an LPi WeConnect site), Our Lady of Mount Carmel and St. Francis de Sales have one administrator, and with St. Joseph the Worker shared a parochial vicar (June 2025 appointments). Resurrection (Farmingville, now coresrcc.com) and St. Sylvester (Medford, LPi link) share a pastor (June 2025). Check both pairs for one bulletin. Also Mary Immaculate (Bellport), St. Jude (Mastic Beach) and St. Joseph (Ronkonkoma).

batches.name: Smithtown, St. James, Nesconset, Hauppauge, Lake Ronkonkoma, Kings Park and Commack
batches.why: St. Patrick (Smithtown), Ss. Philip and James (St. James), Holy Cross (Nesconset, now holycrossrc.org), St. Thomas More (Hauppauge), St. Elizabeth Ann Seton (Lake Ronkonkoma), St. Joseph (Kings Park), Christ the King (Commack). No shared pastor named. The Ruthenian Resurrection (Smithtown) is in eastern-catholic.

batches.name: Port Jefferson, Setauket, Centereach, Selden and Coram
batches.why: Infant Jesus (Port Jefferson), St. Gerard Majella (Port Jefferson Station), St. James (Setauket, LPi 0018000000Qc1NlAAJ), Assumption of the BVM (Centereach), St. Margaret of Scotland (Selden) and St. Frances Cabrini (Coram). No shared pastor named.

batches.name: Rocky Point to Riverhead, Manorville and Center Moriches
batches.why: St. Anthony of Padua (Rocky Point), St. Louis de Montfort (Sound Beach), St. Mark (Shoreham), St. John the Baptist (Wading River), St. John the Evangelist and St. Isidore (Riverhead; St. Isidore also has a Sunday Traditional Latin Mass, listed separately on the Mass-times page), Ss. Peter and Paul (Manorville), St. John the Evangelist (Center Moriches), and the Shrine of Our Lady of the Island (Eastport, GCatholic only): find whether the shrine has a public Mass schedule of its own. The Ukrainian St. John the Baptist (Riverhead) is in eastern-catholic.

batches.name: North Fork and Shelter Island
batches.why: Fr. Michael Bartholomew is pastor of Sacred Heart and Our Lady of Ostrabrama (Cutchogue), St. Agnes (Greenport) and St. Patrick (Southold) (June 2025 appointments), and the June 2026 appointments give the four one parochial vicar: check whether they print one bulletin or several (Sacred Heart, St. Agnes and St. Patrick have separate Solutio sites; Sacred Heart's issues are LPi-printed). Our Lady of Good Counsel (Mattituck) is Sacred Heart's mission (sacredheartolgc.org); GCatholic does not list it. The locator links Sacred Heart Cutchogue to sacredheartnm.org, the North Merrick parish's site: use sacredheartolgc.org. Our Lady of the Isle (Shelter Island) is on its own.

batches.name: South Fork: East Hampton to Westhampton Beach
batches.why: Most Holy Trinity (East Hampton) with its St. Peter mission (Amagansett; Mass only on 2nd and 5th Sundays per the Mass-times page), and St. Therese of Lisieux (Montauk), whose pastor from 2026-09-23 is Most Holy Trinity's pastor 'while remaining Pastor of the Church of the Most Holy Trinity' (June 2026 appointments): check for a joint bulletin since then. Also St. Andrew (Sag Harbor), Queen of the Most Holy Rosary (Bridgehampton), Our Lady of Poland and the Basilica of the Sacred Hearts of Jesus and Mary (Southampton; neither in GCatholic), St. Rosalie (Hampton Bays), Immaculate Conception (Westhampton Beach). The Mass-times page also names an 'Our Lady Star of the Sea Mission Chapel' and a 'Church of St. Andrew' in odd places: read the Sag Harbor and Saltaire entries.

batches.name: Eastern Catholic churches in the territory
batches.why: GCatholic lists these Eastern Catholic churches: Ukrainian St. Vladimir (Hempstead), Holy Family (Lindenhurst), St. John the Baptist (Riverhead) and the Basilian St. Josaphat monastery (Glen Cove); Ruthenian Resurrection (Smithtown) and St. Andrew the Apostle (Westbury); Syro-Malabar St. Mary (West Hempstead, in the St. Thomas the Apostle building). They belong to their eparchies (other-jurisdiction). The Syro-Malankara St. Vincent de Paul Cathedral (Elmont) sits in elmont-floral-park because the Latin St. Vincent de Paul parish uses the same building.

excluded.reason: Duplicate of mass-times:church-of-the-sacred-heart-north-merrick: the Mass-times page lists Sacred Heart, North Merrick (hearttoheartparish.org) under both Merrick and North Merrick; the church is in batch merrick-seaford.

Duplicate of mass-times:church-of-st-isidore-riverhead: the same St. Isidore church, 622 Pulaski Street, listed again for its Sunday 3:30 pm Traditional Latin Mass; the church is in batch riverhead-north-shore.
